findings.claim: Event 20161 is a READBACK_VERIFICADO inventory-only historical snapshot created 2026-10-04, with migration_batch_id null and created_by_execution_id CHATGPT-IG-M10.9-20261004-001.

Current principal is supabase_read_only_user with transaction_read_only=on; it cannot execute fn_input_governance_execute. It can execute the engineering checkpoint transition function, which was not invoked during research.

Across 255 pre-cut runs, Curator identity is always present, Validator identity is null in 7, and no non-null row has equal Curator/Validator identity; component IDs have 3/8 nulls and no equal non-null pair.
No visible public.lf_operation_execution row matches event 20161 created_by_execution_id, although 294 completed ACTUALIZACION_DB_LF operations exist pre-cut.

open_world_alternatives: Historical event authority may live in a legacy or external ledger.
Distinct identity/component fields may correspond to materially separate executions.
A newer governed attestation may exist outside the frozen P0.
